title: logis theme
description: The vestments of the cogitator, kept as themes/<name>.jsonc beside logis.jsonc and chosen by its "theme". JSONC: comments and trailing commas are allowed. Every key is optional: what a theme leaves out comes from the theme it extends, then from the bundled forge-crimson-brass, whose values are the defaults below. Three layers: a palette of named colours, the elements that refer to it, and effects and motion. The machine spirit heeds edits at once; a theme it cannot read leaves the last sound one in force.

$schema.description: The schema this theme is written against, for the editors of the faithful. logis accepts it and heeds it not.

extends.description: Another theme (bundled, or a file in this directory) whose keys this one starts from; one level only. A theme extending its own name amends the bundled theme of that name.

palette.description: Named colours: "#rrggbb" or "#rrggbbaa", or an array of them (named "name.0", "name.1" …). Everything else refers to them by name; "error" colours error notices.

fonts.description: Font roles by name; elements name a role. "body" is the default face.

window.description: The window when the session asks for no size of its own. Its height follows its rows: the prompt line, the rule, the row gaps and rows × row.height (on an output too short for them, as many rows as fit, spread over its height).

width.description: The panel's width (border box) when no --width is given.

height.description: Deprecated and ignored: the panel's height follows its rows. Still accepted (and checked) so Rust v1 themes load.

rows.description: How many rows the panel shows, and so its height, when no --lines is given.

margin.description: Room around the panel for its glow.

color.description: Its colour at the edge; the alpha is its strength.

pulse.description: How far its strength swings (a continuous effect).

highlight.description: A bright spot travelling round the border (a continuous effect), or false.

length.description: Its reach along the border either side of its centre.

fill.description: Top to bottom; translucent colours let the blur show.

padding.description: Left and right of the prompt line and the rows.

blur.description: Blur behind the body (when the config's blur allows it and the compositor offers it).

rivets.description: A rivet in each corner, or false.

top.description: The upper pair, top-left to bottom-right.

bottom.description: The lower pair, top-left to bottom-right.

prompt.description: The start of the prompt line.

height.description: The prompt line's height, from the body's top to the rule.

label.description: A word before the session's prompt, "" for none.

color.description: The label's and the session prompt's colour.

gap.description: Between the sigil, the label and the query.

sigil.description: An image before the label, or false.

image.description: "gear" (drawn by logis in its colour), or an SVG or PNG file relative to this theme's directory.

color.description: The colour of a sigil logis draws.

shape.description: A thin bar, a block or an underscore.

width.description: A bar's width (a block or an underscore is a character wide).

rule.description: The line under the prompt line.

inset.description: From the body's left and right edges.

dash.description: Dash and gap lengths, or false for a solid line.

ornament.description: A boss at the rule's middle, or false.

height.description: From one row's top to the next.

gap.description: Above the first row and below the last.

padding.description: From the body's left edge to the row's text.

columns.description: Per tab-separated column; the last repeats.

column-gap.description: Between one column's widest text and the next column. Columns are as wide as the widest text shown in them so far; the last takes the rest of the row.

column-max.description: The most of the row's width a column other than the last may take; wider text ends in an ellipsis.

band.description: The band behind it, left to right.

outline.description: Lines above and below the band.

edge.description: The bar at the band's start (transparent for none).

inset.description: From the body's left and right edges.

selected.description: Their colour on the selected row.

weight.description: Their weight (the row's families at this weight).

style.description: A pill with an edge, a filled pill, or the text in square brackets.

pending.description: A row whose data has not settled.

shimmer.description: How far its mark's opacity swings (a continuous effect while one shows).

mark.description: What the row says at its end.

effects.description: The CRT pass over the body: a group of settings per effect, each with its strength, where 0 is off. A bare number is the group's strength (the aberration's amount), so logis v1's themes stay valid; v1's bloom, curvature and vignette set glow.strength, roundness.curvature and roundness.vignette. Rolling scanlines, a wobbling aberration, changing grain and flicker move on their own; reduce-motion stills them. The groups diverge from logis v1's seven strengths. The glitch (a pass of its own, before the CRT pass) is new. A custom shader (custom-shader) may run after them all.

scanlines.description: Dark lines across the glass; a bare number is their strength.

strength.description: How dark the lines get; 0 is off.

period.description: Logical pixels from one line to the next, counted from the body's top (v1: 3).

sharpness.description: How thin and hard each line is: 0 a soft wave, 0.25 v1's profile, 1 a hard line one pixel thick.

roll.description: Drift in logical pixels per second, downwards when positive; 0 holds them still (v1). A continuous effect.

glow.description: Light from bright parts spreading to their surroundings (v1's bloom); a bare number is its strength.

strength.description: How much light spreads; 0 is off.

threshold.description: Brightness per channel below which nothing glows (v1: 0.35).

reach.description: Radius of the outer sampling ring in logical pixels, the inner ring at 3/7 of it; beyond 9 more rings keep a wide halo soft (v1: 7).

bleed.description: How much of the source colour the light keeps: 0 a neutral halo, 1 the bright pixels' own colours (v1), above 1 more saturated.

dim-bright.description: 0: every pixel takes the same glow (v1). Towards 1 dim pixels take up to 1.7 times as much and bright ones, or those inside filled bright bands, only 0.15 times: text gets a halo without washing out a highlighted row.

aberration.description: Red and blue sampled either side of green (chromatic aberration); a bare number is its amount.

amount.description: The offset: 2 logical pixels at 1; 0 is off.

edges-only.description: 0: the same horizontal offset everywhere (v1); 1: none at the centre, growing outwards and pointing away from it.

wobble.description: How much the offset varies over time; 0 keeps it steady (v1). A continuous effect.

wobble-rate.description: How fast the wobble runs, in Hz.

twitch.description: The wobble's character: 0 a smooth breathing, 1 calm with sudden short spikes at irregular moments.

mask.description: A CRT's phosphor structure over the picture; a bare number is its strength.

strength.description: How much the structure darkens; 0 is off (v1).

size.description: Its pitch in logical pixels: one dot cell, or one red-green-blue triad.

kind.description: dots: a soft round dot grid; grille: vertical red, green and blue stripes; slot: those stripes broken into slots, every other column shifted like brickwork.

curvature.description: How far the whole panel bows out as one tube face: border, glass and the glow around it bend together, the outline turns convex and every effect lies on the bent glass. 0 is flat. v1 bent only the picture behind a straight border.

corners.description: Extra rounding of the visible glass's corners on the bent glass; beyond them the screen is black. 0 is off (v1).

vignette.description: Darkening towards the glass's corners; 0 is off.

grain.description: Film grain; a bare number is its strength.

strength.description: How strong the noise is; 0 is off.

rate.description: How many times a second it changes (v1: 24); 0 freezes it. Changing grain is a continuous effect.

flicker.description: The brightness trembling (keep it subtle); a bare number is its strength. A continuous effect.

strength.description: How deep the trembling is; 0 is off.

frequency.description: Its main rate in Hz, with a slower irregular modulation riding on it (v1: 7.4802823, 47 radians a second).

glitch.description: The glitch pass before the CRT pass (new in the Go logis; v1 had none): the glass breaks up like a failing signal, gently at rest and hard in episodes (at the end of each ambient period) and bursts (on opening, a switch of tab, at random). A bare number is its strength. Most parts have an amount at rest and one in an episode. Lengths are logical pixels. reduce-motion turns it off.

strength.description: The master strength: it scales the episode intensity and every amount at rest; 0 turns the glitch off (no pass at all).

episodes.description: The ambient cycle: an episode at the end of every period, counted from the panel's opening.

period-s.description: An ambient episode every this many seconds, at the end of each period; 0 leaves episodes to events only.

duty.description: Share of each period an ambient episode lasts (a smooth bell).

wobble.description: The signal's sideways jitter in bands: at rest every band jitters about its pixel; in an episode a few tear far.

rest.description: Largest sideways push of the signal bands outside episodes.

episode.description: Largest sideways push of the signal bands at the peak of an episode.

band-px.description: Height of the tall wobble bands; a second layer of bands is about 0.3 of this.

speed-hz.description: How often the wobble bands are re-rolled.

tracking.description: Two thin kinks sweeping down the glass and kicking it sideways; scaled by the strength only, so they run at rest.

px.description: Sideways kick of the two tracking lines (one left, one right).

height-px.description: Half height of each tracking kink.

a-hz.description: Sweeps per second of the line that kicks left.

b-hz.description: Sweeps per second of the line that kicks right.

fringe.description: Red and blue split either side of green, growing with the wobble.

px.description: Constant offset of red and blue from green, in opposite directions.

growth.description: Extra fringe per pixel of local wobble, so torn bands show red and blue edges.

slices.description: Horizontal slices torn sideways, finer cuts within coarse groups.

rest.description: Share of slices torn sideways outside episodes.

episode.description: Share of slices torn sideways at the peak of an episode.

px.description: Height of the horizontal slices (shared by slice tears and slice flashes).

shift-px.description: Largest sideways shift of a torn slice; groups share a smaller common offset.

group.description: Neighbouring slices per coarse chunk that shares a common offset.

rate-hz.description: How often the set of torn slices is re-picked.

blocks.description: Irregular rectangles of the picture shifted, colour-split and brightened.

rest.description: Amount of block corruption outside episodes.

episode.description: Amount of block corruption at the peak of an episode.

size.description: Scale of the block stripes (1: row stripes about 11 px, column stripes about 56 px).

shift-px.description: Largest sideways shift of the copy shown inside a block.

split-px.description: Red and blue offset inside a block.

brightness.description: How much brighter a block is than the picture.

rate-hz.description: How often the blocks are re-rolled (they blink).

flashes.description: A share of the slices lit up.

rest.description: Share of slices flashing outside episodes.

episode.description: Share of slices flashing at the peak of an episode.

gain.description: Extra light in a flashing slice (0.33: a third more).

rate-hz.description: How often the flashing slices are re-picked.

noise-band.description: One band of coarse near-binary noise at a random height, drawn anew at its rate.

rest.description: Strength of the noise band outside episodes.

episode.description: Strength of the noise band at the peak of an episode.

cell-px.description: Size of the noise band's blocky cells.

min.description: Smallest band height, as a share of the glass height.

max.description: Largest band height, as a share of the glass height.

rate-hz.description: How often the band jumps to a new place and size.

episode.description: Per-pixel white noise at the peak of an episode.

rate-hz.description: How often the static is re-rolled.

line-pulse.description: A dense ripple of brightness near the pixel pitch, drifting; independent of the scanlines.

rest.description: Depth of the dense brightness ripple outside episodes.

episode.description: Depth of the dense brightness ripple at the peak of an episode.

drift-px-s.description: Drift of the ripple; positive moves it up, negative down.

bursts.description: Short episodes logis fires: on events and at random. A burst rises and falls as sin(πt)^0.6 over its length; the glitch takes the larger of it and the ambient cycle.

open-ms.description: Length of the burst when the panel opens, in ms; 0 fires none.

tab-ms.description: Length of the burst on a switch of tab, in ms; 0 fires none.

random-per-minute.description: Random bursts a minute on average, at random (exponential) intervals from the opening; 0 fires none.

random-ms.description: Length of a random burst, in ms.

stutter.description: Share of a burst's 33 ms steps damped to a quarter, so it stutters.

on.description: The events that fire a burst: the panel opening, a switch of tab.

custom-shader.description: A custom post-processing pass after the built-in effects (new beside logis v1): the path of a GLSL ES 3.00 fragment shader file, absolute or from this theme's file, that defines mainImage(out vec4 fragColor, in vec2 fragCoord) as for Shadertoy. logis gives it iChannel0 (the frame after the built-in effects, premultiplied, rows bottom-up), iResolution, iTime (seconds since the panel opened; frozen at 0 by reduce-motion), iFrame and iGlitch (the glitch's intensity, 0 to 1). A panel with a custom pass keeps drawing while it is shown. A shader that cannot be read or compiled is skipped with one line in the log; --check-config compiles it. The config's custom-shader outranks it; "" is none.

vignette.description: logis v1's name of roundness.vignette; give one of the two.

bloom.description: logis v1's name of glow.strength; give one of the two.

curvature.description: logis v1's name of roundness.curvature; give one of the two.

motion.description: Transition timings. LOGIS_MOTION and reduce-motion do not change them; reduce-motion stills only continuous effects.

colour.description: A colour: "#rrggbb", "#rrggbbaa", "transparent", or a palette name ("brass"; "soot.1" for the second colour of a palette entry), optionally followed by "/alpha" from 0 to 1, which multiplies its alpha ("crimson/0.55").

paint.description: One colour, or 1 to 4 colours as evenly spaced gradient stops. Each element says which way its gradient runs.

colours.description: Colours per column; the last repeats for further columns.

length.description: Logical pixels (the renderer multiplies by the output's scale).

role.description: The name of a font role in "fonts".

families.description: Font families in order of preference, resolved by fontconfig (aliases and generic families such as monospace, serif and sans-serif included). A family that is not installed falls through to the next.

font.description: A font role: families, size, weight and letter spacing.

family.description: Families, the most wanted first; the last is usually generic.

weight.description: The OpenType weight: 400 regular, 600 semibold, 700 bold.
